decisions.reason: A cleaning soap is a low-cost accessory that complements the core flooring offer, and with industry turnover growing and the firm hiring, slack allows it to stay despite limited evidence of results.
The maintenance oil line supports the firm's surface-treatment and care positioning for oiled floors and needs few resources, so performance likely meets aspiration.
Care products for oiled floors are standard companions to parquet sales and strengthen customer relationships, with no shortfall signal that would trigger search.
A moisture-protection underlay is a natural system accessory that installers expect, and there is no sign of underperformance against aspirations.
The high-density underlay foam fits the flooring-system offer, and although it may overlap with other underlays, slack makes keeping it the boundedly rational choice.
The oak parquet line is central to the firm's core business and growing market, so dropping it is very unlikely.
